title: László Vetési Kökényesdi (as Cassimirus Miloftzki) to Ferenc Rákóczi II, 9 January 1706 (Ráday Archives C64-4d2-10, 92-95; DECODE R473)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R473 record page, transcription DOC_R473_D3610 and images 3612-3614 with the project cookie (fetch_img.py).
Read DECODE's transcription: Hungarian clear text with numerical cipher runs, each run under a contemporary interlinear gloss.
Checked images 3612 and 3614: the interlinear decipherment is in a contemporary hand over nearly every group; endorsement '1706 I. 9' and closing 'Kilencedik Januarii' date the letter 9 Jan 1706.
Pencil note 'H.o. R.I. 102 a 1 jegyzet. 494. p.' identified as Raday Pal iratai I (1955) item 102 n. 1 p. 494; Szaktars copy paywalled (403), not checked.
Hard-EM alignment of cipher runs with DECODE's transcription of the glosses (align.py) to rebuild the key: too noisy, 154/373 groups in mismatched runs; key not rebuilt.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked DECODE's transcription with its interlinear-gloss lines; a clean transcription of the gloss is missing

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test): DOC_R473_D3610_3610.txt read through; its PLAINTEXT lines (DECODE's rendering of the interlinear) are garbled and no sentence can be built (0 of 43 clean, docs/_check_reading.py). R473 relabelled decoded, not read; class already solved -> not read, method read from existing decipherment -> not solved (the interlinear and the print are not transcribed here).

Re-read b37 step 1: DECODE R473 record re-fetched (three images, DOC transcription, no attachment or comment); all three images read at full resolution; printed edition Ráday Pál iratai I (1955) searched online: not available (REAL-EOD 18464 is the 1709-1711 volume).
Transcribed the clear text and the contemporary interlinear gloss over every cipher run afresh from full-resolution crops (R473_transcription.txt); DECODE's PLAINTEXT lines were too garbled to use.

Scanned the DOC files of neighbouring DECODE records R380-R520 against 18 glossed groups of R473 (b37_keyscan.py): DECODE R446, Rákóczi's Hungarian syllabic key (Ráday Archives C64-4d2-25 no. 6), agrees at 16 of 18; no other key above 1. Its image read to correct DECODE's transcription (69 al, 71-74 an/ar/as/at, 80/70 ö/ü, 35 ly, 296 Belgium).

Decoded every R473 group with R446 and set it against the gloss (b37_vetesi_dec.py, R473_key_vs_gloss.tsv): 253 of 304 agree; the rest spelling variants, key misreadings or writer's slips; groups outside the key (9, 8, 6, 7, 1000, 512, 750 ...) are nulls, unglossed by the contemporary decipherer.

Wrote R473_reading.md and R473_en.md from the key and the gloss: 35 sentences, 0.829 clean on explicit holes (0.086 on the hu word list, which does not know 1706 spelling); word-by-word check R473_align.txt. R473 relabelled read (grade B).
Consistency pass (cl): outcome.key_file added: key/DOC_R446_D2629_2629.txt, the DECODE transcription of Rákóczi's syllabic key R446 applied in the b37 re-read.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The letter carries a contemporary interlinear decipherment (read at the time). 23 Oct 2026 (re-read b37): the gloss was transcribed afresh and Rákóczi's Hungarian syllabic key DECODE R446 (Ráday Archives C64-4d2-25 no. 6), not previously tied to this letter, was found by scanning the neighbouring DECODE key records and applied: it reproduces the gloss at 253 of 304 groups and fills the groups the gloss left garbled (Niszevárat, az király táborba, Belgiummal, hogy Herbaville). The reading rests on both.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 23 Oct 2026, re-read b37: the one document reads (sentence test, R473_reading.md: 0.829 clean sentences on explicit holes), so by documents 1.0; every cipher group has a value from the key and the gloss or is a null outside the key; the open places are doubtful clear words, not cipher. The 22 Oct 0 is superseded.
outcome.notes: Read at the time (interlinear decipherment); date corrected to 9 Jan 1706 and addressee to Rákóczi. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: not read. 23 Oct 2026, re-read b37: gloss transcribed afresh, key R446 found and applied, R473 read (grade B).

credits.note: interlinear decipherment over almost every group

texts.label: R473, 9 Jan 1706
texts.summary: László Vetési Kökényesdi, as 'Cassimirus Miloftzki', to Ferenc Rákóczi II, 9 January 1706, in Hungarian with numerical cipher runs: the French post brings news that Nice castle has passed into the King of France's hands, celebrated in the old church; in Spain the court is malcontent, Valencia has rebelled and Aragon wavers, the Queen will not take up the administration and there is no money; next year the war will be in Italy and Spain, Holland and England prepare against Antwerp, and Holland may tire of the expense and leave the House of Austria; he has had no order from Rákóczi since the order of 30 November, Ráday's December letter is silent, and he commits himself to Rákóczi's disposal.

reading_review.note: R473_reading.md: the contemporary interlinear decipherment transcribed afresh from the three DECODE images and checked group by group against Rákóczi's Hungarian key DECODE R446 (found 23 Oct 2026 by scanning the neighbouring key records; DECODE's key transcription corrected on its image); key and gloss agree at 253 of 304 groups, the rest are spelling variants, DECODE key misreadings or writer's slips (R473_key_vs_gloss.tsv). 35 sentences: 0.829 clean counting explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1; the hu word list does not know 1706 spelling: 0.086 on the list); the holes are doubtful clear words in the faded middle of ff. 93-94. Word-by-word check R473_align.txt: no invented word. No look-alike substitutions (numerical cipher). A reader can follow all but about five sentences.
